usedFor: Todoist holds your tasks, and ActivitySmith pushes each “New Task Created in Project” to your phone.

bestTemplate.name: “New Task Created in Project” in Todoist, then “Send Push Notification” in ActivitySmith
bestTemplate.why: A new task in a chosen project reaches your paired iPhone or iPad as a push notification.

watchOut: Both new-task triggers in Todoist are polling, so the push follows a scheduled check.
